name: Computational Biology
notes: Students in this minor study biological systems using math and computer science.
Students must maintain a 2.0 GPA in the minor, excluding allied field courses.
The course count varies with the paths chosen: the genetics requirement is two courses and the statistics requirement is one or two.

requirementGroups.label: Introductory biology with lab
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following: BIOL 110L: Principles of Biology I with Lab; BIOL 112L: Perspectives in Biology I with Lab

requirementGroups.label: Genetics with lab
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following: BIOL 190: The Human Genome and BIOL 198P: Genetics Lab; BIOL 198: Principles of Genetics and BIOL 198P: Genetics Lab

requirementGroups.label: Programming
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following: CSC 161: The Art of Programming; CSC 171: The Science of Programming

requirementGroups.label: Statistics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: STAT 190 (formerly CSC 262): Introduction to Statistical Methodology OR STAT 180 (formerly STAT 212): Introduction to Applied Statistical Methodology + STAT 216: Applied Statistics Methods

requirementGroups.label: Two computational biology courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two of the following: BIOL 219L: Genomics of Quantitative Traits; BIOL 253L: Computational Biology; BIOL 257L: Applied Genomics
